definition: A plan to reduce spending or cut back on what is provided.
author: Jane Austen
quote: She consulted, and in a degree was influenced by her in marking out the scheme of retrenchment which was at last submitted to Sir Walter.
example_sentence: A year of retrenchment meant no more takeaways.
